description: This file defines the internal Watchdog class responsible for monitoring runtime and component health in an Orleans silo. It manages background threads for platform and component health checks, logs warnings and errors, and handles internal state related to health monitoring.

classes.name: Watchdog
classes.description: Monitors runtime and component health periodically, reporting complaints, managing background threads for health checks, and logging issues.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the platform and component watchdog threads, setting up timers and logging startup messages.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the watchdog by disposing resources and cancelling background threads.

methods.name: RunPlatformWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks runtime health and logs warnings if issues are detected.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeHealth
methods.description: Performs health checks related to GC pauses and thread stalls, logs warnings if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: RunComponentWatchdog
methods.description: Background thread method that periodically checks health of registered participants.

methods.name: CheckComponentHealth
methods.description: Checks health of each participant, logs failures and complaints.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancels background threads.
